data.summary: The reviews present a mixed but plausible picture. The positive reviews are generally detailed and span several years, suggesting a history of satisfied customers. However, the low total review count (13) and the effusive, sometimes vague language in some 5-star reviews raise mild concerns about authenticity. The single, detailed 1-star review adds credibility to the overall set by providing a counter-narrative. The evidence does not strongly point to systematic fakery, but the low volume and stylistic issues in some praise warrant caution.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews are overly effusive with generic praise
Several 5-star reviews lack specific project details
Review volume is low for a company with 5+ years in business
Clustering of 5-star reviews from 5-6 years ago, then a gap
authentic_signals: One 5-star review includes specific details (snow storm 2021, insurance claim, fence work)
One 5-star review mentions a specific timeline (3 weeks for office remodel)
The 1-star review is detailed and describes a specific negative experience
Varied project types mentioned (fence, bathroom, office, floors, water damage)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has a meaningful rating. No other platforms have sufficient data for comparison.

reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Kingdom Keys Construction enough!!!!!

Working with them was an absolute pleasure from start to finish. Not only was he incredibly reliable and efficient, but he also showed a level of transparency and care that you don’t often find in contractors these days. As someone who was a bit nervous about tackling such a big project on short notice AND in an older home, I truly appreciated how patient he was with me, especially when we hit a few bumps along the way.

From the very first meeting, Chris made sure I understood the details of the renovation process. He was always available to answer questions and provided clear explanations when things didn’t go exactly as planned. It wasn’t just about getting the job done. It was about making sure I felt comfortable and informed throughout. That level of dedication to his clients goes a long way, and it’s rare to find someone who truly stands behind their work like he does.

The team did a fantastic job on my kitchen renovation, as well as demoing and re-tiling the floors in the wet areas and updating the vanities in both bathrooms. It was no small task, but they handled it all with professionalism and a high standard of quality. I also have to give a huge shout-out to Chris for managing to start the work before Christmas and wrapping everything up just in time for the New Year. What an amazing way to kick off 2024 for my family!

If you’re looking for a trustworthy, skilled contractor who really cares about the job and their clients, Kingdom Keys Construction is the one to call. Thank you, Chris, for turning my vision into reality and for making this experience as smooth and positive as possible!
reviews.author: Cyrita J

reviews.text:
A pipe busted in our newly purchased home during the snow storm 2021. Chris brought fans & handled the insurance side to get our claim processed super quick. He completely renovated the water damage on the entire house. This included the entire first floor & the flooring upstairs. These are just a few photos. He also redid our fence & gate.

We are forever customers of his.
reviews.author: Albreesha Culberson

reviews.text: Chris and Kingdom Keys Construction are amazing.   Great price - Great communication - SUPER FAST service - Fantastic results. Our fence looks  incredible.  We very highly recommend Chris and Kingdom Keys.
reviews.author: Randy Jones

reviews.text: Our company decided to hire a service provider for our office, based on their outstanding reviews. However, we were greatly disappointed with the quality of work delivered and had to repeatedly bring to their attention the mistakes made. The personnel in charge, Chris, continuously provided excuses for the deficient performance. We were disheartened by the lack of professionalism exhibited by the service provider, as it was unlike any company we had previously engaged in. Furthermore, the service provider caused damage to our property. Despite the significant amount of money paid, the job took almost three months to complete, and even then, the work was substandard. Our new floor keeps coming up, and the service provider only offered to apply super glue, which is temporary. We have decided not to engage their services again. If you require a recommendation for a reliable service provider, kindly send me a message. We have engaged another company, and they have almost completed the job in just three weeks in another location.
reviews.author: Sonia Urquiza

reviews.text:
I chose Kingdom Keys Construction LLC because I saw the work Chris and his team had done in my neighborhood.
Chris arrived on the day scheduled to install my new fence and immediately started taking down the old fence and by the end of the day most of the new fence was installed to my delight. He also communicated well and answered questions that were asked.
He is a respectful and hardworking man and is very detailed in his workmanship and skills.
My new fence was completed in time and looks amazing. I am a happy customer.
I would not hesitate to recommend him to my family and friends and would use him again  for any future projects.
May his business continue to prosper in the years to come.
reviews.author: Annette Booker

reviews.text: I wish I could give more than 5 stars to express how satisfied I am with Kingdom Keys Construction. Chris remodeled our entire 2,000 square ft office building we recently purchased. I'm talking a major remodel, with knocking walls down, building others up, paint, lights, countertops, exterior repair, and the list goes on. He literally touched every part of the building. We had only about 3 weeks from purchase to move-in date, and he was able to get it done on time for us. I am super meticulous and particular, and Chris paid attention to detail, and delivered even better than I had anticipated. The office is simply amazing. I will always recommend his company, and definitely call on him and his crew for future projects. May God bless him and his company.
reviews.author: Ryland Tax

reviews.text: Chris & his team did an outstanding job with my bathroom complete remodel. He was able to open the shower up and extend it. New floors, paint & several other things. They completed the job on time and I will definitely use this company for any work needed

reviews.text: The company did good work with my floors. They laid them very quickly, and my carpet looked amazing. They also painted my upper level which was exactly what I envisioned, and they stained my cabinets. The overall project was great and I will be calling for more work in the future.
